scenario_summary: Customer is disputing an unrecognized charge of $76.00 and requesting a refund if unauthorized.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Katherine Wagner and I'm 80. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?
Hello, Ms. Wagner. I would be happy to look into this for you. To ensure your account security, could you please provide your account number and confirm the billing address we have on file?
Of course. My account number is 8829-4401-22, and I live at 124 Maplewood Drive.

Thank you for that information. I have verified your account. I see the transaction you are referring to: a charge of $76.00 from 'Global Merchant Solutions' on October 12th. Does that name sound familiar, or would you like me to proceed with a formal dispute?
No, that name doesn't ring a bell at all. I haven't shopped anywhere with a name like that.

I understand. Per our Fraud Prevention Policy, I have initiated a formal dispute for this transaction. I have also placed a temporary block on your card to prevent further unauthorized activity and have ordered a replacement card to be sent to your address.
Oh, that sounds like a lot of trouble, but I suppose it's for the best. Will I get my money back?

Yes, Ms. Wagner. Under our consumer protection guidelines, I have issued a provisional credit of $76.00 to your account, which will appear within 24 hours while the investigation is finalized. You will not be held responsible for this unauthorized charge.

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer, identified the unrecognized charge, initiated a formal dispute, issued a provisional credit, and secured the account by issuing a replacement card.
